description: Unit tests for parsing numbers, including overflow, underflow, and invalid inputs, using Google Test framework.

methods.name: CreateOverflowString
methods.description: Generates a string representing a number one greater than the maximum value of type T.

methods.name: CreateUnderflowString
methods.description: Generates a string representing a number one less than the minimum value of signed type T.

methods.name: ExpectParseIntSuccess
methods.description: Tests successful parsing of an integer string into the expected output.

methods.name: ExpectParseIntFailure
methods.description: Tests failure cases for parsing an integer string, expecting specific error.

methods.name: TestParseIntUsingFormat
methods.description: Runs a suite of tests on a parsing function with a specific format.

methods.name: TestParseInt
methods.description: Runs parsing tests for signed integer types.

methods.name: TestParseUint
methods.description: Runs parsing tests for unsigned integer types.
